## %output payloads that stress the decoder and the line splitter (tmux 3.7c encoding, control.c:
## every byte < 0x20 and the backslash as \ooo; 0x7f and 0x80-0xff raw; a pane's data is cut
## wherever the write budget ends, so a UTF-8 sequence or an escape sequence can span lines).
## backslashes: one encoded backslash, two in a row, one before a digit (must stay 2 bytes)
%output %0 C:\134Users\134\134share \1340007
## control bytes: NUL, BEL, BS, TAB, CR LF, ESC, and raw DEL
%output %0 \000\007\010\011x\015\012\033[0m
## UTF-8 cut inside a 2-byte and a 4-byte sequence (raw bytes, as tmux sends them)
%output %1 cafÃ
%output %1 © ğŸ
%output %1 š€!
## an escape sequence cut after ESC [ 3
%output %1 \033[3
%output %1 8;5;196mred\033[0m
## empty payloads: with the trailing space tmux writes, and without it
%output %2 
%output %2
## extended output: age, reserved future arguments, ' : ' inside the data
%extended-output %0 1234 future args : data : with colon
%extended-output %3 0 : 
%extended-output %3 0 :
## text that looks like protocol but is pane output
%output %0 %end 1791899855 7 1
%output %0 %begin 1 2 1\015\012
## a long line (8 KiB of output in one notification)
%output %4 \015\012
## pane 12 (multi-digit id), CR LF line ends from a tty in between are tolerated
%output %12 crlf
